name: cas-erp-monorepo
description: Centre for Advanced Studies (AKTU Lucknow) — Production MERN ERP

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace=@cas-erp/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@cas-erp/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@cas-erp/shared && npm run build --workspace=@cas-erp/api && npm run build --workspace=@cas-erp/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@cas-erp/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@cas-erp/api
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@cas-erp/shared && npm run test --workspace=@cas-erp/api
